# Request Anticipation Notes

This pack assumes the next likely needs will be:
1. Replace placeholder blocks in the PLX library with a recognizable mascot.
2. Stress-test every PLX category with the same canonical character.
3. Provide enough animation breadth that new requests can be fulfilled by recombining existing assets before needing a stronger generator.
4. Establish environment kits and manifest conventions now so the future Art + Sprite Sheet engine has a target file structure.

## Why 300 frames per PLX category?
Because users will naturally ask for more states once a mascot exists. Rather than waiting to be prompted repeatedly,
this pack pre-bakes a wide lane of animation coverage: 20 animation groups x 15 frames each = 300 frames per PLX family.

## What else is included to bridge the gap?
- Character bible
- Expressions
- Turnarounds
- Layered environment kits
- Atlas previews
- Library showcase scenes
- Phaser-friendly animation manifests
